name: colonies-08-wcm-daughter-machine
title: Whole-cell baseline (v2ecoli) in a daughter machine — device run
description:
Run the REAL v2ecoli whole-cell BASELINE — the full 55-process EcoliWCM — as a
single cell inside the daughter-machine device geometry (chamber + absorbing
wall), letting it grow and divide naturally. Renders the running animation and
the same phenotype figures as the cheap-agent device studies (size at
division, birth→division time, added size before division), so the whole-cell
tier can be compared, in the same device, against the simple viva-munk agents
(colonies-06) on the identical measurement pipeline.

This run is compute/RSS-bounded: a whole-cell division is ~one cell cycle
(~2300+ ticks) and a growing colony leaks per-cell RAM (OOM ~gen 3), so it is
capped at a few generations. Phenotype distributions are therefore PRELIMINARY
(small n); conclusions are held for experimental data (colonies-09) and full
distributions need HPC. The value here is the genuine whole-cell baseline
running inside the device.

baseline.name: wcm-daughter-machine
baseline.note:
The whole-cell (EcoliWCM) tier placed into the daughter-machine geometry via
v2ecoli.colony_bench (build_bench_core('wcm') + geometries.daughter_machine).
Bounded natural-division run; phenotypes extracted by colony_bench.phenotypes,
figures by colony_bench.viz — the same pipeline as colonies-05/06.

pipeline_gate.proceed_condition:
The whole-cell (EcoliWCM) tier in the daughter-machine geometry; reuses the
colonies-06 device + phenotype pipeline. Compute/RSS-bounded run.
